relevance_note: Single-patient case report of Alexander disease type II with a GFAP variant: 'A mutation analysis of the GFAP gene revealed the known [6] pathogenic variant ... confirming the diagnosis'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script in my scratch directory only assembled the JSON and checked spans. One in-scope person (the single unnamed patient, label 'patient'); no relatives described. The variant string in the paper contains a no-break space and thin spaces ('c.208 C > T'); spans were copied character for character. Age at diagnosis taken from Table 1 row '45 Diagnosis of AxD'. Vital status 'alive' from 'The patient’s condition currently remains stable'. Zygosity, inheritance and variant type are not stated for this person (only the general statement that AxD is caused by a dominant mutation), so left not reported. Normal findings: 'the video-oculography was normal' and 'The caloric irrigation testing was normal' are whole investigations; recorded as excluded 'abnormal video-oculography' and 'abnormal caloric irrigation testing' as the paper words them, excluding nothing more specific. 'preservation of the pontine volume' recorded as excluded 'pontine atrophy'. Weak gag reflex was not counted as dysphagia; weak lower-limb reflexes were not counted for limb weakness or pyramidal signs. Cerebral peduncle, cerebellar and pontine hyperintensities were not counted as cerebral white matter abnormality (checklist left not reported). Table 1 has no stacked ' / ' cells. No contradictions found. The supplementary material (Video 1) is not included in the text.
